text:
alex: Quick preflight for tonight's RN + deploy (02:00 UTC). I'm assembling the internal announce and notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/s/release-2026-03-22
marie: grabbed it, adding customer bullets and the exec blurb. can someone trim the feature lines to one-liners for the announcement? :memo:
alex: @sue can you do the microcopy pass and the known-issues short-form? keep each item <=2 lines.
sue: yep. will push edits by 00:30 UTC. flagged EU privacy/locales blurb for legal.
jon: i'll be oncall for the window. deploy-bot scheduled to run at 02:00. i'll monitor metrics and trigger rollback if thresholds exceed.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: tag release/v2.14.3 -> production
deploy-bot: Planned start: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z | est duration: 15m
marie: there's one billing-related line that legal wants eyes on. @legal-bot any ETA on wording guidance?
legal-bot: doing a focused sweep now. expect suggested wording / OK in ~15-20m. will flag if this needs a hold.
alex: plan if legal requests a hold: delay by up to 1 hour; avoid splitting rollout unless absolutely required.
jon: rollback rules we've agreed: sustained error_rate > 0.5% over a 5m window OR p95 latency +300ms over baseline. rollback command if triggered:
```
# rollback to last stable
deploybot rollback --target release/v2.14.2 --reason "post-deploy regression"
```
sue: microcopy edits uploaded. shortened feature bullets, tightened the known-issues and added quick customer mitigation lines.
marie: updating the internal announce snippet. draft:
"Heads-up: rolling v2.14.3 at 02:00 UTC. Fixes: fewer embedding cold-starts, improved routing fallback. Standby: @jon. Rollback on error spike or latency regression. Details: <doc-link>"
alex: LGTM. i'll pin the doc and set the deploybot cue once legal confirms.
legal-bot: billing wording OK. suggested minor tweak for EU privacy sentence; updated the doc with alternative phrasing.
alex: final timeline:
- 01:40 UTC: notify ops channel
- 01:50 UTC: run smoke tests (staging)
- 02:00 UTC: deploy start
- 02:15 UTC: check metrics and health
- 02:30 UTC: escalate canary -> 100% if green
@jon you'll be primary rollback owner, @sue will publish microcopy to comms.
jon: noted. i'll post status updates here during the window. :thumbsup:
marie: if green i'll post the internal announce and short RN blurb to #general after 02:30. if not, i'll post incident note and link to the postmortem doc.
alex: checklist recap: doc pinned, legal cleared, deploybot scheduled, oncall ready, microcopy done. ping once doc is pinned. :white_check_mark:
